label: Qwen Text to Image
description: Qwen-Image 2.1 makes a new image from a text prompt. No inputs. Output: an EXR in ACES2065-1 at the size you set.
usage: Makes a new image from the prompt (Qwen-Image 2.1, local). It has no inputs.
'width' and 'height' set the size. Native is up to 2048x2048. Use multiples of 32.
The official pipeline uses about 40-50 steps; 25 is the template's faster start.

highlights: 'roll off' (default) brings the result back through the inverse of ACES Output - sRGB, so near-whites come back hot (display 0.98 = about 7, 1.0 = about 16). 'clip' reads it as plain sRGB, so whites stay at 1.
Press Render in ComfyUI; Bring in output reads the result under the node.
License (checked 2026-11): Qwen Research License - research or evaluation only. Paid work needs a separate license from Qwen.

output.tooltip: Qwen makes a display-referred image; 'highlights' sets how it comes back to scene-linear.
